title: Add bounded controlled-DNS CNAME chains and reconcile current project documentation

firmware.reason: The committed gate exercises the controlled resolver and Device Service policy, not a guest CNAME-to-TCP/HTTP lifecycle.

checks.name: exact_terminal_cname_chain
checks.detail: Two CNAME links plus the terminal A record are returned

checks.name: domain_suffix_terminal
checks.detail: A CNAME alias resolves through a policy-bound suffix answer

checks.name: cname_query
checks.detail: CNAME query returns the chain without inventing an address

checks.name: negative_graphs
checks.detail: Cycle, uncontrolled terminal, unauthorized alias, exact/domain owner conflict and overlong chain are rejected

checks.name: device_service_policy
checks.detail: Valid CNAME config is accepted; invalid policy and graph data return invalid_network

checks.name: documentation_consistency
checks.detail: Dynamic counts are snapshot-driven and NET-07 preserves the guest-lifecycle boundary

notes: This is resolver-data-plane and contract validation, not guest firmware lifecycle validation.
NET-07 is the remaining same-guest CNAME through TCP/HTTP gate.
Public DNS, DNSSEC, rebinding resistance, RF and physical hardware are not claimed.
